phaseName: Phase 1: Signal Discovery + Golden Cross Audit
goal: Surface original Golden Cross backtest + map all signal paths + audit data depth
summary:
Phase 1 complete: Signal Discovery + Golden Cross Audit.

Deliverables:
- docs/BACKTEST_PLAN.md (12KB): Complete signal path map for all 7 subsystems, data depth audit, dead code inventory, backtest implementation plan
- Original system found: 0-5 binary sum model (Decision 068, March 2023). Discrete backtest scripts: backtest/aae_quant_backtest_5y.py, backtest/quality_backtest.py
- Critical finding: swing_trades has 0 rows, client_signals has 0 rows — the system has NEVER executed a live trade or signal
- Data depth: stock_scores only from 2024-03-25, daily_prices from 1996, Nifty50 benchmark from 2023

All 5 steps verified with gates.
stepSummaries:
1. Audit frontend HistoryPage and PerformancePage for stale code, hardcoded metrics, or references to the original EMA cross/Golden Cross system [verified]

  3. Read signal_generator.py, swing_execution_engine.py, engine_perx/scoring.py, engine_core/regime_engine.py to map current signal paths [verified]
  4. Query DB for earliest dates per table and document coverage gaps [verified]
  5. Document dead/stale code paths (0-5 binary model, unused signal branches, stale backtest scripts) and exclusions [verified]
